column2: Retain all Israel's enrollment in the book of Israel's and Judah's kings with those deported to Babylon for lawlessness. The inherited finite is recorded smooths a nominal/participial construction; Judah is not detached into a different deportation sentence.
column3: How does with those deported relate to the registry's scope and the combined royal-book title?

column2: Retain former residents in their possessions and cities, Israel, priests, Levites and given ones. Formerly follows proteron without adding a specific return-from-exile date; given ones remains an unresolved institutional label.
Retain Jerusalem residents from Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim and Manasseh. Some reflects the repeated partitive from rather than an assertion that each whole tribe lived there.
Retain Gothi, Ammioud, Amri and the compressed a son of the sons of Phares son of Judah. No missing individual from a parallel genealogy is inserted into the son-of-sons expression.
Retain the Selonites, Asaia his firstborn and his sons. The first possessive's antecedent remains unresolved rather than being replaced by the clan's chief.
Retain Jiiel, their plural brethren and six hundred ninety from Zara's sons. Their is not normalized to singular his despite the preceding one named person.
Retain Benjamin's Salo and his lineage through Mosollam, Odouia and Sanaa. The chain continues into a list rather than a new complete sentence.

Retain Ibanaa son of Iraam, the selected these-were-sons-of-Ozi son-of-Machir insertion and Massalem's lineage. The unusual plural identification is not replaced by another named descendant from a different witness.
column3: Which preceding figures does these identify, and how does that relation coexist with their stated fathers?

column2: Retain nine hundred fifty-six brethren, generations and the repeated ancestral-house description. The total and all-men-leaders statement are not rounded or narrowed.
Retain the priestly heading and Jodae, Joarim and Jachin. The following Azaria lineage is another entry under this heading.

Move leader of the house of God directly after Azaria so the English title clearly describes him. The Greek nominative hegoumenos agrees with the listed Azaria, while the intervening fathers stand in genitive relationships; final placement in English can misleadingly attach the title to Achitob. Preserve every ancestor and retain the inherited order in the close draft.
Retain Adaia's Iraam/Paschor/Malchia line and Maasaia's five-generation line through Emmer. The semicolon separates the two men rather than making the second a descendant of the first.

Retain one thousand seven hundred sixty priestly brethren, ancestral-house leadership and strength for sanctuary ministry. The strength expression is not automatically recast as military service here.
Retain the Levite heading and Samaia's Asob/Esrikam/Asabia line from Merari. No alternate Hashabiah-style form is imposed on the inherited names.
Retain Bakbakar, Ares, Galal and Manthanias with his Micha/Zechri/Asaph ancestry. The last patronymic series is not distributed across all four listed men.

Retain Abdia's lineage through Idithon and Barachia's through Elkana, followed by Netophati village residence. Who dwelt is contextually attached to the listed Barachia, but the intervening lineage leaves an English antecedent question.
column3: Does the residence participle describe Barachia or his ancestor Elkana, and should its position be clarified after review?

column2: Retain Salom, Akoub, Talman, Aiman and brethren as gatekeepers, with Salom explicitly ruler. The named leader is not omitted as a repeated name.
Retain until this time, the eastern royal gate and the selected gates of Levi's camps. Gates is not silently changed to gatekeepers, and the incomplete time/location opening remains visible.
column3: What implicit action links the opening temporal phrase to the royal gate?

column2: Retain Salom's Kore/Abiasaph/Kore lineage, the Korite brethren, tent guard duties and their fathers guarding the Lord's camp entrance. The two Kore occurrences remain rather than being merged.
Retain Phinees son of Eleazar as former leader and these were with him. The selected these is not replaced by the Lord, and no divine-presence formula is imported.
Retain Zacharias son of Masalami as gatekeeper at the Tent of Testimony's door. The singular door and the tent designation remain.

Retain the repeated gates phrase, two hundred twelve, courts and enrollment, and appointment by David and Samuel the seer in their faithfulness. Courts and faithfulness are inherited provisional choices rather than resolved administrative terminology.
column3: Do courts mean village compounds here, and does faithfulness describe reliability or an entrusted office?

column2: Retain these men and their sons guarding gates in the Lord's house and tent-house. The paired sanctuary expressions are not collapsed into a different building label.
Retain four winds and the east, sea, north, south sequence. Sea preserves the selected directional image; its westward force is contextual and should not be treated as an additional fifth direction.
Retain brethren in their courts arriving for seven-day periods from time to time with these. The schedule is not converted into an exact rotation calendar beyond the selected wording.

Retain four mighty gate men in faithfulness and Levites responsible for chambers and treasuries. Serve supplies an English predicate to the in-faithfulness expression without claiming a separate service verb in this clause.
Retain future camping around God's house, assigned guard duty, keys and opening sanctuary doors morning by morning. The explicit keys and repeated morning are not reduced to generic daily access.
Retain some assigned to ministry vessels and the future bringing in and out by count. Both inventory directions and the repeated count remain.
Retain vessels, all holy vessels, fine flour, wine, oil, frankincense and spices. The expanded assignment list is not reduced to generic supplies.
Retain priestly sons as perfumers for perfume and spices. No specific recipe or anointing use is added to this selected occupational statement.

Retain Mattathias as Levite and Salom the Korite's firstborn, entrusted with the high priest's pan offering. The high-priest qualification is explicit in the selected Greek, not imported from a ritual parallel.
Retain the named Banaias the Kaathite, presentation loaves and preparation Sabbath by Sabbath. The singular named responsible man is not changed to an unnamed plural family group.

Retain psalm singers, Levitical ancestral-house rulers, assigned divisions and day-and-night work. The selected appointed divisions are not rendered exemption from other duties without lexical evidence.
column3: How does the feminine divisions phrase relate grammatically to the masculine singers and rulers?

column2: Retain repeated rulers, ancestral houses, generations and Jerusalem residence. The repeated leadership wording remains as in verse 28 of the preceding chapter.
Retain Gabaon's father explicitly named Jiiel and wife Moocha. The name supplied in this selected verse is not backfilled into 8:29 where it is absent.
Retain his firstborn Abadon, Sir, Kis, Baal, Ner and Nadab. The masculine his differs from 8:30's feminine her and is not harmonized.
Retain Gedour, a brother, Zacharia and Makelloth. The selected brother noun lacks the earlier his, and the different Zacharia/Makelloth forms remain.
column3: Does a brother stand as a separate unnamed list entry or describe one adjacent named person?

column2: Retain Makelloth begetting Samaa and residence among and with brethren in Jerusalem. Among here differs from opposite in 8:32; both are preserved in their own selected passages.
Retain Ner/Kish/Saul descent and Saul's Jonathan, Melchisoue, Amminadab and Isbaal. Isbaal is not silently changed to the preceding chapter's Asabal or another biblical alias.
Retain singular Jonathan's son Maribaal and his begetting Micha. The singular son and changed name forms are not harmonized to 8:34's plural heading and Meribaal/Michia.
Retain Micha's Phaithon, Malach and Tharach. Achaz is absent from this selected list and is not added merely because he begins the next verse.
Retain Achaz begetting Jada, Jada's three sons and Zambri begetting Masa. The changed Jada, Gazmoth and Masa forms remain rather than being conformed to chapter 8.
Retain Masa begetting Baana and Raphaia, Eleasa and Esel with son links. The selected Eleasa form stays distinct from the preceding chapter's Elasa.

Retain six sons, Esdrikam as firstborn, four further names and the final Esel's sons summary. As in 8:38, five named entries and six stated remain unresolved; the different Esdrikam and Saria forms are not silently standardized.
column3: Does a textual or name-division issue explain the repeated count discrepancy, and how should that be documented without adding a name?
